item.title: Email Announcement: Web Hosting Migration
item.description: Dear Authors, Researchers, Reviewers, and Readers, Please be informed that the website of the Archives of Breast Cancer journal will be undergoing updates to transfer its domain and hosting. This process will commence at 12:00 EST on May 23, 2024, and may result in temporary inaccessibility for up to 48 hours, concluding at 11:59 EST on May 25, 2024. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation during this period. Thank you.

item.title: APC for submissions after 1st September 2024
item.description: Since its inception in May 2014, Archives of Breast Cancer has established itself as a respected publication in the field. Over the past decade, our journal has been indexed in prominent databases such as Scopus, Embase, EBSCO, Index Copernicus, and DOAJ. Our editorial team comprises a dedicated group of scientists and researchers across various specialties. During this time, we have published hundreds of articles, which have garnered thousands of citations from esteemed international journals.

item.title: ABC Annual Best Reviewer Festival
item.description: Starting in 2024, the Archives of Breast Cancer will host an annual festival to honor the best reviewers who have contributed to the journal. Reviewers will be evaluated based on several criteria, including the scientific and professional quality of their reviews, the clarity of their comments, adherence to deadlines, and the number of reviews completed. item.title: Editorial Board Membership Opportunity – Archives of Breast Cancer
item.description: Dear Colleagues, We are pleased to invite distinguished experts to join the Editorial Board of Archives of Breast Cancer (ABC), a peer-reviewed, open-access journal dedicated to advancing knowledge in breast cancer diagnosis and treatment. We welcome applications from specialists in the following fields: Epidemiology and Research Methodology Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Psycho-oncology, psychiatry, Psychology Cancer Biotechnology and Molecular Oncology Medical Oncology Radiology
